notes.content:

TWO WEEK SALE & MARCH 2024 UPDATE

Hey Blinders! 

Save 20% on Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition until Sunday 21st March! It's a great time to time to pick up the game as we've just released a brand new update introducing several quality-of-life improvements. These changes greatly improve the post-game experience, making it much easier to navigate the world and access the many DLC missions and challenges.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903670/Peaky_Blinders_The_Kings_Ransom_Complete_Edition/

Fast Travel

Now you can fast travel directly from the Pause Menu. If you’re in Garrison Lane, but you want to get the Gold medal in the Headshot Challenge in Pennyfields, for example, it's now much quicker to get to where you want to be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/fb776584214edd5ddfc9607caa398fe59886c18c.png
Progress Tracker in the Player Hub

Head to Rowena’s Van in the Player Hub to see your current progress on all the DLC. You can find posters for completed missions and medals displayed for shooting galleries and challenges. Keep checking back to see how much there is left to do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/63d941379cbde7492f17e3aef92d68cd272b8f7b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/1546e7b5584a5acb246f0b792bd65fdba15cef24.png
Waypoints and Highlighted Interactables

All DLC content is now clearly highlighted with visible waypoints in the sky and around blackboards. Additionally, lockboxes and keys needed to access the missions are also outlined. It should now be a breeze to find your way and get back into the post-game action!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/971349cd589374032ecbcf45dddd8887124994ea.png
Many thanks to the Peaky Blinders VR community for sharing your valuable feedback! We hope these improvements allow you to get the most out of Freeroam Mode and all it has to offer!

WIN A CUSTOM META QUEST 2

Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom, Maze Theory & POPeART have teamed up to offer you the chance to win a very special anniversary prize!

Bespoke, Custom-Made Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Meta Quest 2 Headset​

This premium skin wrap, designed exclusively for Maze Theory by renowned 3D designer, POPeART, features a gritty black-and-white design, Shelby family iconography and the iconic razor blade on top of the headset.

To enter, click here. You have until Saturday 16th March to enter this giveaway, so don't delay!

notes.title: Save 30% this week during Steam VR Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/14ebca567ca49349d009e172ceb0d82d3949bc5c.png

Hey Blinders!

We are delighted to be taking part in the Steam VR Fest where you can now save 30% on Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition - this week only!

It's a great time to jump into the game, as the latest patch was released last week. You can now tailor your gameplay experience with new graphic quality and performance settings in the main menu. We've also implemented a bunch of graphical optimizations to ensure that the game runs as smoothly as possible.

If you're joining us for the first time, check you some more details about Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition before you dive into Small Heath. Thank you for your support!

PLAY NOW

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903670/Peaky_Blinders_The_Kings_Ransom/

What is Peaky Blinders: The King’s Ransom Complete Edition?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/6f57f52c2ebafc3efb3f8c93001349fcb14c40b1.gif

Peaky Blinders: The King’s Ransom Complete Edition represents the legendary TV series’ first foray into the world of virtual reality, and will immerse players in a vivid 1920s criminal underworld. Explore detailed environments, come face-to-face with intriguing characters, and fight your way through fast-paced shootouts as you uncover a plot that could change the country forever.

The Complete Edition contains all additional content that has been and will be released for the game - more on this below!

What To Expect

Immersive World: Step into the mean streets of 1920s Birmingham and London and explore iconic locations from the show, including The Garrison pub, Charlie’s Yard, and Shelby’s Betting Shop.

Believable Characters: Come face-to-face with Tommy Shelby (voiced by Cillian Murphy) and Arthur Shelby (voiced by Paul Anderson) like never before. Interact with iconic characters as you uncover allegiances and confront your enemies.

Intense Action: Life in Small Heath is full of opportunity – and risk. Immerse yourself in dramatic action as you take down rivals and move up in the world.

Epic Crime Drama: On the run from the firing squad, you turn to the infamous Tommy Shelby for help, and soon find yourself at war once again. Your only hope at redemption is to defeat the odds and win at any cost… By order of the Peaky Blinders.

The Complete Edition: After completing the main story, return to the gameworld in Free Roam, and take on shooting galleries and combat challenges, and be rewarded with item skins and player customisation options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/9fbcff2bda22dab9bb913490861f8b104e33f158.gif

notes.title: First Update Available Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/90c67989d0eb0db09e3f857ffa616d13a6f05d13.png

Hi Blinders. 

We wanted to let you know that a patch is now available for Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition which addresses the feedback shared at launch by members of the community. We have implemented a number of measures to improve the gameplay experience. Please note that you still may experience slight differences depending on your chosen hardware and specifications.

The team wanted to thank all our players for their patience and understanding as we worked to execute these improvements. For a summary of the changes, please see below.

Achievements:

 All achievements will now correctly activate as intended, meaning it is now possible to earn 100% completion

Graphics:

 Various improvements to lighting and textures
 Baked shadows now correctly apply to all scenes of the game

If you are still experiencing any issues, there is a beta patch available that automatically applies some performance optimisations. You can access this by opting into the beta for Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition. Continued support is available at peakysupport@emergent-entertainment.com and by joining our Discord server: discord.gg/peakyblindersvr


See you in Small Heath!

notes.title: Peaky Blinders: The King’s Ransom @ EGX 2022
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/ce6d0982671c4435e75193fe1baf220180ed27b5.png

Greetings all,

Last week we had the divine pleasure of taking Peaky Blinders: The King’s Ransom to EGX at ExCeL London, where the great public were able to get their hands on the game for the very first time! A truly momentous milestone for us all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/af03b48935a3e0009ba80b8423936dc37c2e2111.jpg

Four long days spent interacting at an IRL event, with hundreds of curious, excited, passionate, incredible fans, many queuing for up to an hour to play the game, is something that will live long in our memories. Your reaction was quite frankly overwhelming. 

Here’s a brief selection of what the press had to say after coming face to face with the notorious Shelby gang…

"A superfan's dream come true"
- Eurogamer

“A fascinating VR experience worthy of attention”
- GamesRadar

“Peaky Blinders is a standout VR Game and easily is one of the best VR games ever made to date!"
- Games Enquirer

“The story and environment were mighty impressive, but the game mechanics were mind-blowing”
- Movies Games and Tech

“This might just be the game that The Peaky Blinders deserve and a reason for people to jump into VR in the first place”
– Finger Guns


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936965/9bfbdc2d2f0f0773295f41a51866ea8413464237.jpg

We’d like to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who took the time to speak to us and play the game. It means a lot. There is much more to come from us over the coming weeks and months as we edge closer to launch. For now, don’t forget to Wishlist the game and follow our social channels for the latest news and updates - BY ORDER OF THE PEAKY BLINDERS!
